payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including the use of a variant of Byte-Pair Encoding for word segmentation and experimenting with different translation units.

claims.text: A variant of Byte-Pair Encoding algorithm was proposed to perform effective word segmentation for Vietnamese texts, alleviating the rare-word problem in NMT systems.
Methods were chosen to alleviate the data sparsity problem in NMT when applied in low-resourced settings.
Experiments were conducted with translation units at different levels: subword, word, and beyond to address rare-word translation problems.
